name: Raitrick
description: A Mercadian sorcerer fused with a Derelor into the Delraich who kills the caravan that wronged him.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raitrick is fused with a Derelor into the Delraich and murders Sleedge's caravan.
timeline.quote: The Delraich goes out and murders the entire caravan, including Sleedge, finally getting his revenge.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Delraich , by Jess Lebow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
